Comment: Trust policy for the IAM role GitHub Actions assumes. No long-lived AWS keys are stored in the repository; the workflow exchanges its OIDC token for short-lived credentials. NOTE: GitHub issues subject claims containing immutable numeric IDs (repo:OWNER@OWNERID/REPO@REPOID:ref:...), not the plain repo:OWNER/REPO:ref:... form most guides show; a policy written the plain way is denied with AccessDenied. Read the real claim from CloudTrail (AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, userIdentity.principalId) and paste it below. Replace ACCOUNT_ID before use.
